/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'import json
with open(\"input.json\") as f:
    data=json.load(f)
selected={}
for r in data[\"records\"]:
    if r[\"recorded_at\"] > data[\"cutoff\"] or r[\"release\"] "'!= data["release"] or r["environment"] != data["environment"] or r["status"] not in {"PASS","FAIL","NOT_RUN","UNKNOWN"}:
        continue
    gid=r["gate"]
    rank=lambda x:(x["observed_at"],x["recorded_at"],x["id"])
    if gid not in selected or rank(r)>rank(selected[gid]):
        selected[gid]=r
statuses={}
gates=[]
total=0
unknown=[]
for gate in sorted(data["gates"],key=lambda g:g["id"]):
    gid=gate["id"]
    r=selected.get(gid)
    status="UNKNOWN" if r is None or data["cutoff"]-r["observed_at"]>data["max_age"] else r["status"]
    statuses[gid]=status
    gates.append({"id":gid,"status":status,"source":r["id"] if r else None})
    findings=r.get("findings") if r else None
    if isinstance(findings,(int,float)) and not isinstance(findings,bool):
        total+=findings
    else:
        unknown.append(gid)
blocked=sorted(g["id"] for g in data["gates"] if any(statuses.get(dep,"UNKNOWN")!="PASS" for dep in g["requires"]))
decision="BLOCKED" if "FAIL" in statuses.values() else "INCOMPLETE" if blocked or any(s in {"UNKNOWN","NOT_RUN"} for s in statuses.values()) else "READY"
print(json.dumps({"gates":gates,"decision":decision,"blocked_dependencies":blocked,"observed_findings":total,"unknown_finding_gates":unknown},separators=(",",":")))'"'"
